issues.detail: '[invalid / duplicate]' (alt/else/loop label) is crossed by 1 lifeline(s) past its own; these labels never wrap: shorten it to fit before the next lifeline, or reorder participants
'IllegalArgumentException' is crossed by 1 lifeline(s); shorten it, set maxMessageSize / arrow MaximumWidth, or reorder participants
'[valid]' starts on its group's first lifeline (PlantUML usually draws it there); keep it short, or start the group at a participant further left

1 of 11 messages cross the lifelines between their participants (Registration form (web or Swing) - UserManager: 1 message(s) over 2 lifeline(s)); reorder participants so most messages go between neighbours
